description: adamw + StackRec on SASRec/Beauty. One continuous training run that progressively activates the last 2, middle 4 and all 6 transformer layers.

interpretation.layer_scales: Per-layer forward coefficient. A zero coefficient makes the layer an identity (it is skipped); newly activated layers are ramped from 0 to 1.

stages.2_layers: layers 4,5 trained; layers 0-3 frozen with scale 0
stages.4_layers: layer 4->2 and 5->3; layers 2-5 trained; scales of 2,3 ramped
stages.6_layers: layer 2->0 and 3->1; all 6 layers trained; scales of 0,1 ramped

interpretation.aux_identity: When a new group is stacked below the trained subnet, the output scalar of its last layer becomes trainable and an auxiliary loss drives ||g * output|| / ||input|| to 1 at the interface. Its weight follows the linear-complement law lambda(alpha) = lambda0 * (1 - alpha), so it decays linearly while the new-group scale alpha ramps from 0 to 1.
interpretation.selection: best_complete_* are metrics at the best validation ndcg@10 among epochs where all ramp coefficients reached their final values. final_* are metrics at the last epoch of the stage.
interpretation.hyperbolic_heads: Optional Poincare-ball next-item heads attached to the output of each newly stacked group. The boundary representation and the item table are mapped through expmap0 and scored by negative hyperbolic distance. Curvature follows c(depth) = c_ref * (depth_ref / depth) ** power (or is learned), so deeper/upper heads use a flatter, larger ball. Only available when the encoder exposes add_hyperbolic_head(); otherwise the branch is disabled with a warning.
interpretation.hyperbolic_residual: Lorentz/hyperboloid residual heads attached to the output of every copied group. The residual is the curvature-induced correction of the Lorentz exponential map, so it is exactly zero at c=0. It is multiplied by a gate ramped from 0 to 1, rescaled to the norm of the boundary state, added, and the sum is renormalised back to that norm. Thus at the moment a group is stacked the model is exactly the pretrained subnet, and the input norm of the pretrained subnet is preserved throughout the ramp. Curvature ramps from 0 to the stage target (0.2 for the first copy, 1.0 for the second copy).

hyperbolic_residual.normalization: the residual is rescaled to the norm of the boundary state, added with a gate ramped from 0 to 1, and the sum is renormalised back to that norm
